name: Privileged Security Group Membership Addition
detects: Addition of a member to a governed privileged security group using Windows group-membership audit events.
does_not_detect: All account creation or all group changes; privilege scope is derived from a governed SID/object-ID inventory.
logic: Match 4728, 4732 or 4756-equivalent membership-addition event when enriched group identity is governed as privileged.
confidence: High when stable group identity is present
tuning: Do not suppress simply because actor is an administrator. Classify authorised test/change after alert using change/test context.
risk: Display-name-only allowlists are spoofable and localization-sensitive.
response: Validate actor session, member identity, privileged-group SID/object ID, change approval, associated account creation and post-change activity.
test_status: Tested with local canonical evaluator and public fixture suite; source-derived validation references reviewed
platform_status: No native SIEM execution; platform files are syntax/semantic candidates only
